sloka: न शक्यम् सौप्तिकम् कर्तुम् रामस्य विदित आत्मनः ।वधश्च पुरुष व्याघ्रे तस्मिन्न् एव उपपद्यते ।। ६-३३-९।।
transliteration: na śakyam sauptikam kartum rāmasya vidita ātmanaḥ ।vadhaśca puruṣa vyāghre tasminn eva upapadyate ।। 6-33-9।।

translations.english: "Rama is a knower of his Self. It is not possible to kill him while he is asleep. Nay death is not possible for he is a tiger among men."
